Welcome to Dr. Spine – an evidence-based spinal sciences and chiropractic center in Bangalore.

Struggling with back pain, neck pain, slipped disc, sciatica, migraines, posture issues, or scoliosis? Our internationally trained chiropractors and rehabilitation specialists help patients recover naturally through non-surgical spinal care.

We specialize in Spine, Restructuring, stabilizing, Functional and Structural Rehab.

90,000+ patients treated with evidence-based chiropractic care focused on restoring mobility, posture, and quality of life while helping many avoid unnecessary surgery.

Our approach combines chiropractic adjustments, posture correction, rehabilitation, and advanced spinal therapies.

🔔 Subscribe for spinal health tips, recovery stories, posture advice, and home exercises.
🔔 Subscribe to Dr Spine Daily: https://www.youtube.com/@DrSpineDaily

📍 Indiranagar | Whitefield | New BEL Road
📞 +91 75 5070 5070 🌐 Website 📘 Facebook 📸 Instagram 💼 LinkedIn – Prof. Dr. Jayul Doshi
